payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates over positions from leftmost beacon to a large upper bound, using 1D DP: dp[i] = max saved beacons up to i. For a beacon at i with power b, dp[i] = dp[i-b-1]+1, else dp[i]=dp[i-1]. Answer = n - max(dp).
payload.rationale: The solution computes maximum number of saved beacons via a 1D DP array indexed by position. State transition uses previous state at i-b-1, characteristic of dp_1d_state. No sorting or multidimensional DP is used.
